summary: Codex CLI has no per-call model-request identity, so DelegationSigningProxy dedups Responses on the content fingerprint, which can wrong-merge two distinct same-content calls within one stage/attempt.
probe_method: strings(1) of the shipped native codex binary. ModelProviderInfo exposes http_headers, but they are resolved once executor-side (static-per-process); there is no model-request-level per-call header or Idempotency-Key. The unblock signal is a hyphenated, model-request idempotency-key (HTTP header or request field).
unblock_condition: Codex model-provider config or model request carries a value that varies per call (per-call header interpolation, or a stable per-call Idempotency-Key on the Responses request). When the probe detects an unblock_signal, remove the content_fingerprint fallback in openmontage/delegation_proxy.py and close KB-001 in docs/KNOWN_BLOCKERS.md.
